issue.title: sase-listen: per-narrator max_chars config key for OpenAI-compatible (Kokoro-FastAPI) voices
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1e3.5 (engines phase, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2) and triaged by the sase-1e3 land agent on 2026-10-01. The epic plan's engines contract says the OpenAI adapter's max_chars (default 3,500) is overridable per narrator for Kokoro-FastAPI. The adapter takes a per-call override, but NarratorConfig in src/sase_listen/config.py has no max_chars key, so users cannot set it under narrators.<name>.max_chars. Add the key (positive int, optional), thread it from narrator resolution into EngineLimits for chunk planning, document it in docs/narrators.md (Kokoro profile) and docs/configuration.md, and add config plus planning tests.

task_type_fields.proposal: Add narrators.<name>.max_chars to sase-listen config, threaded into OpenAI-compatible engine limits and pipeline chunk planning, so Kokoro-FastAPI and similar backends can lower the 3,500-char ceiling
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Deploying Kokoro is explicitly out of scope for epic sase-1e3 (plan Design decision 8), and the config schema was owned by the scaffold phase, so the engines phase deferred the key

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1e3.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2): the OpenAI-compatible adapter already accepts a per-call max_chars override, but config cannot set it, so a Kokoro-FastAPI narrator profile cannot tune its chunk ceiling.
